remarks: Beautifully situated on a rise, this gorgeous Georgian Colonial welcomes family & friends through stone pillars, up the horseshoe drive to the picture perfect entryway. With over 5000 sq ft the 6 bedrooms, spacious living areas, flexible spaces, & a beautifully landscaped 1 acre, 38 Pequot Trail is ready to be enjoyed! On the main level you are greeted by a spacious foyer that leads into the formal living room spanning front to back with a traditional fireplace and a picture window for viewing the gardens. The light & bright family room is wrapped in windows with multiple sitting areas for lounging, conversation & play! Continuing through the French doors connecting family room, living & dining room we are led back to the kitchen & great room. The open plan connecting the eat-in kitchen w the vaulted ceiling den is wonderfully open & sunlit, with access to both the patio and deck! A half set of stairs leading to two bedrooms (or office/flex space) is connected by a Jack & Jill bath + a home office & powder room finish the main floor. Upstairs there are 3 family bedrooms, 2 baths. Entering the primary suite there is a lovely marble bath with garden views, followed by a grand scale bedroom w sitting area in the turret, a dressing space & massive walk in closet. The lower level is finished w a rec room, a billiards room a wine cellar. The outdoor space is lined w mature plantings for privacy & flow between the entertaining spaces & levels of grassy areas for exploration & play!
